apply_order: 0. Identity: confirm remote is https://github.com/dehai168/ax630c-plate-face-demo. Record the candidate base ref/commit. This is ready_to_investigate, not ready_to_apply.

1. Hash-check the three v2.4 base files listed below (and preferably the unchanged guards). If any required base SHA mismatches the archive member, STOP. Do not apply, do not invent hunks, do not retarget to a 'close' file.
2. Apply R40_INTEGRATION_EXACT.diff from repo root: git apply -p1 --check, then git apply -p1. Check failure or conflict: STOP.
3. Install src_color5_crop_policy.inc as src/color5_crop_policy.inc with exact bytes. Do not modify INTEGRATION_EXACT.diff to insert this file.
4. Verify post-R40 expected SHAs. Mismatch: STOP.
5. Apply R46_MINIMAL_DERIVED_FORMAT_FIX.diff: git apply -p1 --check, then git apply -p1. Check failure or conflict: STOP. Do not apply R46 to vanilla v2.4.
6. Verify final expected SHAs, including new src/approved_special_format.inc.
7. Create an independent non-production branch only after steps 1-6 pass. Do not merge to production, do not compile, do not infer, do not deploy in this step.
stop_rules: Any required base or post-apply SHA mismatch.

Need to edit hunks, relax paths, or 'fix' whitespace to make a patch apply — stop and report instead.
